title: Session 總結：Phase L(18)+M(8) 完成，知識系統上線，論文 9,692 字
description: Session 2026-03-16 summary: Phase L(18)+M(8)=26 research items. Paper 9692 words. Knowledge index 1081 docs (LanceDB+Gemini). Key findings: Hybrid VT 10/10 crisis protection, timing alpha 5.77%, w=2000 upgrade improves VaR to 0.8%, FIGARCH null result, cross-asset window specificity. User-driven improvements: sample size analysis (Hwang 2006), self-questioning methodology, immediate publishing discipline.
